utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can help with setup and sorting on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks, Uli. Could you start with setup and then help sort the items as people arrive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you help set up and sort supplies on the front porch Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, absolutely — I can help set up and sort supplies on the front porch Saturday. Just point me to where you want things put.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help on Saturday at the front porch. I’ll do setup and sorting for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik. Quick update: we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll send the new details soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess. I’ll have the tools ready and we’ll get everyone set up Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — thank you! I’ll see you Saturday on the front porch, and your help with the tools will make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — could you come by around 10 AM? I could use help greeting folks, sorting repairs, and handing out tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Tess — I’ll be there at 10 and I’m happy to help greet folks, sort repairs, and hand out tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you help set up and sort things on the front porch this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — could you help set up and sort things on the front porch Saturday? That would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m still on for Saturday on the front porch. I can help with setup, sorting, and greeting people for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for the reminder. I can take sorting and greeting people, if that helps.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
